title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 8: the families of Benjamin, the inhabitants of Jerusalem and Gibeon, and the house of Saul.

questions.text: Who was Benjamin's firstborn, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second and Aharah the third.

questions.text: Which two wives of Shaharaim are named in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, and Hushim and Baara were his wives.

questions.text: Verse 12 names Eber, Misham, and Shemed, the sons of Elpaal. Which places does that verse say were built?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 lists the sons of Elpaal, Eber, Misham, and Shemed, "who built Ono and Lod, with its towns."

questions.text: Beriah and Shema put to flight the inhabitants of which city?
questions.explanation: Beriah and Shema were heads of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath.

questions.text: According to verse 28, where did these heads of fathers' households live?
questions.explanation: These were heads of fathers' households, chief men, and they lived in Jerusalem.

questions.text: What was the name of the wife of the father of Gibeon?
questions.explanation: The father of Gibeon, whose wife's name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

questions.text: Kish became the father of whom?
questions.explanation: Ner became the father of Kish, and Kish became the father of Saul.

questions.text: Who was the son of Jonathan?
questions.explanation: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal, and Merib Baal became the father of Micah.

questions.text: How many sons did Azel have?
questions.explanation: Azel had six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.

questions.text: What does the last verse say the sons of Ulam were?
questions.explanation: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons and grandsons.

answers.text: Mighty men of valor and archers
